note: Slice assignment targets, the third of the three shapes an assignment target can take here: bit_select_assign covers the continuous bit-select and its partial-driver lowering, procedural_bit_select the Member inside a process, and this one the Slice. hif-frontend#9's fix had to unwrap both Member and Slice through getTerminalPrefix. The fields are three bits over five rather than two halves, so an off-by-one in either bound moves bits across the boundary instead of landing back on itself. Behavioral because a shifted bound is a legal slice that still writes the whole register.
